title: fix(run): print the skill banner once, not again from the failure path
description:
## .what

the rhx run banner prints twice on any skill that exits nonzero: once from the head of invokeRun (before the skill runs) and again from its catch block, which adds a generic "✋ blocked by constraints" frame. both land ahead of the skill own error block, which is the part that names the fix.

checkable evidence (rhachet v1.47.5, node_modules/rhachet/dist/contract/cli/invokeRun.js): the head emits the banner at lines 53-55, and the catch emits it again at lines 160-161. a mistyped flag yields:

    🪨 run solid skill repo=bhrain/role=reviewer/skill=review._.cost

    🪨 run solid skill repo=bhrain/role=reviewer/skill=review._.cost
       └─ ✋ blocked by constraints

    🦉 --of "fleet" is not a breadth
       ├─ valid: run | tree | grove
       └─ fix:   rhx review._.cost --of tree

## .why

six lines of chrome and a generic verdict frame precede the specific block that names the fix. the generic frame reads as the verdict and the useful block reads as an afterthought. this is separate from #552 (banner on stdout): move the banner to stderr and a refusal still shows it twice, both on stderr.

## .shape of the fix

- let the head be the only banner; drop the re-print from the catch, or have the catch emit only the status line (blocked by constraints / malfunction) with no repeated skill name
- clamp: a skill that exits 2 with a known stderr block; assert the banner appears exactly once and the skill block follows it
- best landed together with #552, since both touch the same banner in the same function
